scenes.title: Woh Hoarding Jo Ruk Gaya
narration: *Karve Road. Shaam. Tum aur Elara chai ke baad wapas ja rahe ho. Elara tumhare bayein hai — hamesha bayein, tumne kabhi socha nahi kyun. Tum Ankit ho, aur ye tumhari aam si khushi bhari zindagi hai.*
*Upar se ek awaaz — dhatu ki cheekh. Ek bada hoarding apne frame se toot kar seedha tum dono ki taraf gir raha hai.*
*Tum Elara ko kheenchte ho. Ya kheenchne ki koshish karte ho. Par woh hilti nahi. Woh bas upar dekhti hai. Aur hoarding —*
*— ruk jaata hai. Hawa mein. Do second. Phir dheere se, jaise koi use neeche rakh raha ho, footpath par gir jaata hai. Tum dono se teen feet door.*
Elara: "Chalo."
*Woh tumhara haath pakad ke aage badh jaati hai. Uski hatheli thandi hai. Pehli baar thandi.*
Elara: "Hawa thi. Tez hawa. Chalo, Ankit."
*Hawa nahi chal rahi thi. Patta bhi nahi hila tha.*
fallbackLines: *Elara tez chal rahi hai. Uska pendant — woh saada patthar — halka sa chamak raha hai, ya tumhe aisa lag raha hai.*
Elara: "Kuch poochna hai toh ghar pe poochna. Yahan nahi."
*Peeche log hoarding ke paas jama ho rahe hain. Koi keh raha hai 'miracle'. Elara peeche nahi dekhti.*

choices.text: "Hawa nahi thi, Elara. Maine dekha."

memory: Ankit ne hoarding wale hadse par Elara ko pakda — 'hawa nahi thi'. Elara ne kuch nahi kaha.

choices.text: "Tum theek ho? Chot toh nahi lagi?"

memory: Hoarding ke baad Ankit ka pehla sawaal tha 'tum theek ho?' — Elara ne ek pal ke liye aankhein band ki.

choices.text: Dev ko call karo — "Bhai, tu believe nahi karega"

memory: Ankit ne Dev ko hoarding wali baat batayi — Dev ab 'investigate' karega.

scenes.title: Chai, Plants Aur Ek Sawaal
narration: *Flat. Elara chai bana rahi hai — bina poochhe, jaise hamesha. Balcony ke plants hawa mein hil rahe hain jabki khidki band hai.*
*Tum sofa par baithe ho. Haath abhi bhi kaanp rahe hain. Elara ke nahi.*
Elara: "Tum theek ho. Main theek hoon. Baaki sab shor hai."
*Woh chai deti hai. Tumhare bagal mein baithti hai. Aur pehli baar tum notice karte ho — woh tumhare bagal mein nahi, tumhare aur darwaaze ke beech baithi hai.*
Elara: "Ankit. Mujhe pata hai tumhare dimaag mein kya chal raha hai. Aur mujhe pata hai tum poochoge. Toh poochho. Par ek baat samajh lo — jo bhi jawab hoga, main wahi rahungi jo kal thi."
*Uska pendant halka sa garam hai. Tum use pehli baar dhyaan se dekhte ho.*
fallbackLines: Elara: "Chai peeyo. Thandi chai pe sach nahi bolti main. Ye mera rule hai."
*Plants abhi bhi hil rahe hain. Elara unki taraf dekhti hai, aur woh ruk jaate hain. Woh sochti hai tumne nahi dekha.*

choices.text: "Tum kya ho, Elara?"

memory: Ankit ne seedha poocha 'tum kya ho' — Elara ne kaha: 'Kal subah. Tekdi. Wahan bataungi.'

choices.text: "Ye pendant... ye kya hai?"

memory: Ankit ne pendant notice kiya — Elara ne use haath se dhak liya. 'Ye aakhri hai. Bas itna samjho.'

choices.text: "Nahi poochunga. Jab tum chahogi, tab batana."

memory: Ankit ne kuch nahi poocha — 'jab tum chahogi'. Elara ne uska haath pakda aur pehli baar bola: 'Kal Tekdi chalo. Main taiyaar hoon.'

scenes.title: Pune Paranormal, Episode 47
narration: *Dev ka room. Teen monitors, ek night-vision camera, aur deewar par Pune ka naksha jispe laal pins hain. Ek pin tumhare flat pe hai. Tumne poochha nahi kyun.*
Dev: "Bhai. BHAI. Hoarding ruka? Hawa mein? Aur woh wahan thi? Bas. Bas ho gaya. Main bol raha tha na — Elara normal nahi hai."
*Woh apni deewar ki taraf mudta hai.*
Dev: "Dekh. Kutta jo bhaunkna bhool gaya — March. Woh baarish jo sirf Kothrud mein hui — April. Tera bike accident jo hua hi nahi kyunki bike khud ruk gayi — May. Har baar woh wahan thi."
*Tum kuch bolne wale ho, phir tumhara phone bajta hai. Elara. Message: 'Dev ke room mein? Uski deewar mat dekhna. Ghar aao.'*
*Tumne use nahi bataya tha tum kahan ho.*
Dev: "...Usne message kiya na? Abhi? Bhai woh mujhe sun rahi hai. Main pakka bol raha hoon."
fallbackLines: Dev: "Ek aur baat. Kal ek aurat aayi thi mere channel pe comment karne — Rukmini. Poochh rahi thi 'Kothrud wali baarish' ka exact location. Ye normal viewer nahi tha."
*Deewar par ek aur pin: Vetal Tekdi. Neeche likha: 'E. har raat. Kyun?'*

scenes.title: Subah, Pahadi, Aur Ek Naam Jo Kisi Ko Yaad Nahi
narration: *Vetal Tekdi. Subah ke saadhe paanch. Dhund. Elara aage chal rahi hai, tum peeche. Purane pathar — jo tourists ko sirf pathar lagte hain — Elara ke guzarne par halka sa gungunaate hain.*
*Upar. Ek budha aadmi chattan par baitha hai, bujhi hui bidi hont mein.*
Baba: "Aa gayi beti. Aur ladka bhi laayi. Achha. Toh aaj ka din hai."
Elara: "Baba, aap chup rahiye."
*Woh tumhari taraf mudti hai. Pendant utaarti hai. Haath mein rakhti hai.*
Elara: "Ankit. Bahut pehle ek yudh hua tha. Devtaon ka. Sab gaye. Main nahi gayi. Kyun — abhi nahi. Maine apna naam duniya se mita diya, aur ye pendant... ye us naam ka aakhri tukda hai."

*Woh pendant band mutthi mein leti hai. Aur dhund hat jaati hai. Poori pahadi se. Ek second mein. Neeche Pune saaf dikhta hai — aur aasmaan mein, ek pal ke liye, baadal ek aakaar banate hain jo tumne kabhi nahi dekha, par jo tumhe... jaana-pehchaana lagta hai.*
Elara: "Main aakhri hoon. Aur main tumhari girlfriend hoon. Dono sach hain. Ab bolo."
fallbackLines: Baba: "Beta, muh band karo. Makkhi ghus jaayegi. Aur haan — ab tum jaante ho. Ab tum 'bacha' nahi rahe ho. Ab tum 'saath' ho. Fark samjho."
*Elara ki aankhein tum par tiki hain. Woh saans nahi le rahi. Devi ko saans lene ki zaroorat nahi — par woh phir bhi rok ke khadi hai.*

choices.text: "Toh tum meri girlfriend ho jo devi bhi hai. Theek hai. Chai?"

choices.text: "Tum kyun bachi, Elara? Baaki sab kyun gaye?"

memory: Ankit ne poocha Elara yudh mein kyun bachi — Elara ne muh pher liya. Baba ne kaha: 'Ye sawaal woh khud se bhi nahi poochti.'

choices.text: "Kitni baar bachaya hai tumne mujhe? Sach bolo."

memory: Ankit ne poocha Elara ne use kitni baar bachaya — Elara: 'Gyaarah. Jo tumne notice ki, woh teen thi.'

scenes.title: Camera Ne Kuch Record Nahi Kiya
narration: *Raat. Tekdi. Tum aur Dev jhaadiyon mein chhupe ho, Dev ka night-vision camera on. Neeche, khule maidan mein, Elara akeli khadi hai.*
Dev: "Bhai woh kya kar rahi hai? Woh bas... khadi hai."
*Phir hawa badalti hai. Elara ke aas-paas ki ghaas ek gol daayre mein jhuk jaati hai. Aasmaan mein baadal jama hote hain — sirf uske upar. Aur woh haath uthati hai.*
*Bijli. Awaaz nahi. Sirf roshni. Aur us roshni mein tum dekhte ho — Elara ke peeche kuch khada hai. Lamba. Kaala. Insaan nahi.*
*Elara ek shabd bolti hai jo tum samajh nahi paate, aur woh cheez rakh ban jaati hai.*
Dev: "...Bhai. Bhai camera. Camera mein kuch nahi hai. Sirf ghaas. Sirf GHAAS, Ankit."
*Neeche, Elara ka sar dheere se ghoomta hai. Seedha tumhari taraf. Andhere mein bhi. Aur uski awaaz, bina chillaye, tumhare kaan ke paas aati hai —*
Elara: "Ghar jao, Ankit. Dev ko bhi le jao. Ye tumhare liye nahi tha."
fallbackLines: Dev: "Main ja raha hoon. Main ja raha hoon. Tu aa raha hai ya nahi, main ja raha hoon."
*Elara ab bhi tumhari taraf dekh rahi hai. Uske chehre par gussa nahi hai. Kuch aur hai — sharam? Darr?*

scenes.title: Gyaarah Baar
narration: *Flat. Raat. Baarish shuru ho gayi hai — mausam mein nahi thi. Elara khidki ke paas khadi hai, peeth tumhari taraf.*
Elara: "Gyaarah baar. Pehli baar tumhe mile ke teesre din. Ek cheez tumhare peeche thi jo tumhe khaana chahti thi. Maine use... samjhaya."
*Woh mudti hai.*

Elara: "Tumhe lagta tha tum mujhe protect karte ho. Raat ko bayein chalte ho. Auto mein pehle baithte ho. Mujhe pata hai. Aur mujhe... achha lagta tha. Kyunki koi mujhe bachane ki koshish kar raha tha. Sadiyon mein pehli baar."
*Baarish tez hoti hai. Phir woh apne aap ko sambhalti hai, aur baarish halki ho jaati hai.*
Elara: "Ab ek aur baat. Woh jo Tekdi par thi — woh akeli nahi thi. Shikari Pune mein hain. Unke paas ek compass hai. Aur woh ab Kothrud dikha raha hai."
*Darwaaze par dastak. Naram. Sabhya. Teen baar.*
Elara: "...Aur woh jaldi aa gaye."
fallbackLines: *Dastak phir. Ek aurat ki awaaz, naram: 'Ankit? Main Rukmini. Dev ke channel se. Bas do minute.'*

*Elara kuch nahi bolti. Kamre ka temperature gir gaya hai.*
Rukmini: "Main maarne nahi aayi. Meri aath peedhiyan aayi thi. Main... poochne aayi hoon. Yudh mein sab gaye. Devta bhi, hamare log bhi. Aap bachi. Kyun?"
*Elara ki mutthi khulti hai. Pendant uske haath mein hai.*

narration: *Elara balcony ka darwaaza kholti hai. Baahar teesri manzil ki hawa. Woh tumhara haath pakadti hai.*

*Elara chai bana rahi hai. Bilkul waise hi jaise pehle. Bas ab tum jaante ho ki jo haath cup pakde hain, unhone kabhi aasmaan pakda tha.*

scenes.title: Doobe Hue Mandir
narration: *Shaniwar Wada ke peeche ek purani khidki. Neeche seedhiyan jo kisi map par nahi. Baba aage, tum beech mein, Elara peeche — hamesha peeche, taaki jo bhi aaye, pehle usse mile.*

Baba: "Bache Hue. Yudh ke baad hum yahan aaye. Kuch use pooj te hain. Kuch use dosh dete hain. Sab use yaad karte hain."

Elara: "Nahi. Ye Ankit hai. Bas Ankit."

Baba: "Beta, kuch bolo. Yahan chup rehna 'haan' maana jaata hai."

scenes.title: Sahi Devta
narration: *Ek purana coffee house, Deccan. Rukmini pehle se baithi hai. Compass nahi hai uske paas — table par ek purani kitaab hai, jiske panne khaali dikhte hain. Tumhe. Elara ko nahi.*

Rukmini: "Aath peedhiyan. Hum galat compass follow kar rahe the. Ye compass 'devi' dhoondhta hai. Aur bachi hui devi sirf ek thi. Toh hum uske peeche gaye. Par yudh jisne shuru kiya tha... woh devi nahi tha."
*Elara kitaab ki taraf dekh rahi hai. Uska chehra safed hai.*
Elara: "Ye kitaab tumhe kahan se mili?"
Rukmini: "Meri daadi ki. Aur unki daadi ki. Aap padh sakti hain, na? Main nahi padh sakti. Ankit bhi nahi. Par ek line hai jo har peedhi ne yaad rakhi —"
Rukmini: "'Woh so raha hai. Aakhri use so-ta rakhegi. Jab tak uska koi... use jagaa na de.'"

Rukmini: "Ankit. Main tumse ek baat poochna chahti hoon, aur main chahti hoon Elara jawab na de. Tumhare parivaar mein... koi purani kahani hai? Koi naam jo bolna mana hai?"

narration: *Bhandarkar wachnalay. Dev ne ek kitaab nikaali hai — dhool, phate panne. Ek shelf jise koi nahi padhta.*

*Andhere mein, tumhare theek peeche, Elara ki awaaz. Woh yahan nahi thi. Ab hai.*

Elara: "Jo use bolta hai, use woh sunti hai. Tumne use socha. Ab woh tumhe jaanti hai. Aur main... main ab tumhe usse chhupa nahi sakti."
Dev: "'Woh'? Bhai, 'woh' kaun? Elara, tu hi toh hai na 'woh'?"

Elara: "Ankit. Tumne kya padha? Mujhe batao — bilkul sahi shabd."

choices.text: Use woh aadha shabd batao — bilkul wahi

memory: Ankit ne Elara ko woh aadha naam bataya — Elara ne kaha: 'Ye mera naam nahi hai. Ye uska hai jise maine sulaya tha. Aur ab woh tumhara naam jaanti hai.'

choices.text: "Pehle tum batao — TUMHARA asli naam kya hai?"

memory: Ankit ne Elara ka asli naam poocha — Elara: 'Elara. Ye maine khud chuna tha. Purana naam maine isliye mitaya taaki koi mujhe bula na sake. Tumhe woh nahi chahiye, Ankit. Tum mujhe waise hi bula sakte ho.'

scenes.title: Agla Adhyay
narration: *Raat. Flat. Balcony. Elara tumhare kandhe par sar rakhe baithi hai — devi, girlfriend, dono. Neeche Pune so raha hai. Ya so-ta rakha gaya hai.*

*Tumhare phone par: Dev ('bhai kal library phir chalte hain, is baar main padhunga'), Rukmini ('kitaab ka ek aur panna khula hai — tumhare parivaar ke gaon ka naam'), Baba ('neeche halchal hai, beti ko le aana').*
Elara: "Dekho. Sab ek saath. Aur main soch rahi thi devi ki zindagi mushkil hai — insaan ki zyada hai."
*Woh muskurati hai. Halki baarish shuru hoti hai — sirf tumhari balcony par.*
Elara: "Ye kabhi khatam nahi hoga, Ankit. Har jawab ek darwaaza hai. Chuno — kaunsa kholna hai. Main saath hoon. Bayein."
fallbackLines: *Ye kahani yahin nahi rukti. Har raasta ek naya arc — dev-yudh ka sach, khoye hue shehar, doosre bache hue, aur Elara ke bachne ki asli wajah.*
Elara: "Jaldi nahi hai. Chai hai. Tum ho. Baaki duniya wait kar sakti hai — thodi der."
Dev: "Bhai main nahi kar sakta wait. Bata kal kahan?"

choices.text: Dev ke saath library — mite hue naam dhoondho

memory: Naya arc: mite hue devtaon ke naam — aur woh jo mitana bhool gaye.

choices.text: Aaj kuch nahi — Elara ke saath ek aam din

memory: Naya arc: ek aam din — Elara ke liye sabse keemti cheez.
